snippet.title: Multiplayer, Fishing, Mining, And More! (Early Gameplay Footage)
snippet.description:
🌸 Welcome to Cozy Crossroads! A cozy multiplayer game where you can fish, chop wood, mine ore, and explore a peaceful world with friends.
🏡 Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/yS2WehDZpS

In this new Cozy Crossroads showcase, get your first look at multiplayer fishing, mining, and more! Dive into a laid-back, pixel-art world where you can team up with friends or explore solo—whether you’re reeling in a catch by a tranquil lake or unearthing valuable ores in the mountains.

We also reveal an early glimpse of our cosmetic customization features, letting you personalize your character and express your unique style. Are you drawn to bright outfits or subtle accessories and whimsical patterns? There’s plenty of room for creativity. If you enjoy a friendly atmosphere, gentle progress, and the freedom to shape your own adventure, Cozy Crossroads might just be your new favorite multiplayer indie game!

Cozy Crossroads is created with love by Term & Zera, a pair of married Game Devs chasing their dreams of creating games for the whole world to enjoy.

💬 What do you think of the video? Let us know in the comments!

🎥 Check out our full playlist of Cozy Crossroads Content:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLl1kYzfJzQ7eM00Nwcdq6wXzMugDTYxVh

📌 Follow us for updates:
Twitter: https://x.com/cozy_crossroads
Discord: https://discord.gg/yS2WehDZpS

🎶 Music Credits: Happy Folk Acoustic - u_98o9hlkn7r
